outcome: Composite adverse fetal outcome (admission to a neonatal intensive care unit, metabolic acidosis, or Apgar score < 7 at 5 min)
cohort: The study included 722 pregnant women at >= 40+0 gestational weeks referred to a tertiary hospital.
finding: A comprehensive clinical examination at 40-41 gestational weeks can identify pregnancies suitable for expectant management until 42 gestational weeks, yielding similar maternal and fetal outcomes to those induced earlier.
mod_finding: The rate of intrapartum cesarean section did not differ significantly between the expectant management group and the primary induction group.
gest_age: >= 40+0 gestational weeks, with expectant management up to 42 gestational weeks
